title: Koala eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#d4d8e2'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 52 Q50 57 56 52' stroke='#8a7a9a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws holding snack -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='54' r='6' fill='#c2c6d2'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='5' fill='#c2c6d2'/>
